newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as budget fears dissipate.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as budget fears dissipate.

text.p: UK shares ended higher for a third day on Thursday, as worries over next week's budget eased and nerves were calmed by a firm early showing on Wall Street.
Extending a rebound from Tuesday's near-seven week low, the FTSE 100 index closed 17.9 points higher at 4,657.9, with gainers in a three-to-two majority. The Dow was up 22 points as London closed.

Dealers said there were signs of investors "window-dressing" by loading up on stocks which outperformed in the first half, which ends next week. And there was some talk of a "relief rally" if the budget next Wednesday proves market-friendly.
